slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: Insurance renewals fall on a fixed date each year, but the amount can rise more than expected due to market conditions or claims history. A short-term facility can smooth a larger-than-planned renewal without disrupting the rest of the budget.

caption:
An insurance renewal landing higher than budgeted is a common, if frustrating, surprise, and it doesn't have to mean diverting cash from other planned spending. A short-term facility can smooth the cost over a defined period instead.

It's also worth using the moment to shop around and review whether current coverage still matches the business's actual needs.
